connector.name: MuntuAI
connector.registryDescription: Hosted MCP server for MuntuAI outreach campaigns, leads, senders, domains, and analytics.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.muntuai.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the design-smith account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token in the format: Bearer mnt_<keyId>.<secret>. Create an agent key in MuntuAI Settings -> Agent Keys.
